en: Black‑and‑white view of a wide, straight street lined with ornate late‑19th‑ or early‑20th‑century brick buildings in Northern European style. In the foreground left is a large, stately corner building with steep, tiled roof, stepped and curved gables, and tall mullioned windows, fronted by a decorative metal fence. Farther along the street are additional institutional‑looking buildings with similar gables and small spires. At the far right stands a slender tower with an onion‑like spire. Pedestrians, a horse‑drawn cart and early street furniture are visible, but there is no printed caption or writing on the image itself.
